'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Dan Bordier DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Bordier]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Don Bordier
* '''Username:''' dbordier
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
